assumption.demand: market volume and workload mix remain constant
assumption.fitness: empirical distribution among currently stable incumbent endpoints
assumption.price_change: input, cache-read, and output prices scale proportionally
assumption.routing_status: stable; 99% clears the documented 95% normal-routing gate

interpretation.insufficient_data_tool_lower_bound: zero tool-cohort share until the endpoint reaches a known-good tier
interpretation.known_good_tool_tier: tool cohort holds its anchor share while only non-tool traffic reprices
interpretation.not_included: new-endpoint ramp, capacity ceilings, explicit provider pinning, or guaranteed Auto Exacto tier
interpretation.p10_p90: empirical stable-incumbent scenario band, not a calibrated confidence interval
interpretation.p50: median stable-incumbent-equivalent planning case after ramp
interpretation.revenue: gross customer-facing endpoint billings before OpenRouter/provider commercial terms
interpretation.top_level_scenario_fields: optimistic upper-elasticity case where all traffic is price weighted
